title: Roasted Tomato Soup

items.sub: Vegetable or chicken stock for more depth

steps.x: Halve tomatoes through the equator. Cut side up in the basket with onion and unpeeled garlic. Drizzle with oil and a pinch of salt.
Air fry at 200°C for 18–20 min until tomato edges char and flesh is soft. Garlic should be soft inside the skin.
Scrape everything into the saucepan, including juices. Squeeze garlic out of skins, discard skins.
Add water, sugar, pepper and oregano. Bring to a gentle boil, simmer uncovered 10 min.
Off the heat, blend with hand blender until completely smooth.
Low heat, add cold butter, stir until incorporated. Adjust salt. Serve immediately.

notes: Cut side up so juice collects in the cavity.
Don't peel garlic before roasting; the skin stops it burning.
Fresh tomatoes only; canned will steam and mess up the air fryer.
Serve with a grilled cheese sandwich.
